title.en: Analyze water use: April reading 118 cubic draft first public walkthrough — direct evidence organization

user_goal.ko: 월별 변화량과 퍼센트 변화를 계산하고 관찰된 증가와 근거 없는 원인 주장을 구분해줘. 봄 전시 초안 사례에만 답하고 기록이 정하지 못한 것은 표시해줘. 근거 중심 정리 관점에서 판단하되 원자료의 근거를 드러내줘.
user_goal.en: Calculate month-to-month changes and percentage changes, and distinguish the observed increase from any unsupported claim about its cause. Answer for the spring exhibit draft case only, and mark anything the record does not settle. Use a direct evidence organization lens while keeping the source evidence visible.

task.expected_artifact: A small trend table with calculations and a causality caution. for this spring exhibit draft case.
